sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Only obtainable from paid Twitch Drops.
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Info
sections.text: The Twitch rare dogtag case is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 25 inventory slots in a 5x5 grid and only takes up 1 inventory slot itself. Only Dogtags besides default ones can be stored in it.
